protocol.name: D5 complete-trajectory multimodal architecture gate
protocol.motivation: D4 improves average relational geometry but deterministic rollouts fail matched DEV

architecture.mode_scope: one coherent mode per complete 38-step counterfactual trajectory
architecture.gate_inputs: initial privileged state and action sequence only
architecture.decoder: shared action GRU plus learned mode embeddings and residual trajectory decoder
architecture.deployment: argmax action-conditioned gate; no physical future, task label or failure label

training.objective: proper mixture likelihood + D4 response/topology/commitment/boundary + task-free balance/routing regularization

pilot_gate.noncollapse: every deployed mode has at least 5% validation occupancy
pilot_gate.topology: lower topology and commitment error than deterministic full-D4 seed 1
pilot_gate.quiet: no higher than deterministic full-D4 seed 1 (0.1667)

protocol.if_pass: replicate fixed seeds 1-5 on TRAIN before any new DEV run
protocol.if_fail: stop privileged Jenga architecture search and reassess the monitor/model interface

conclusion: Stop privileged Jenga architecture search; do not replicate or open DEV/TEST. Reassess the monitor/world-model interface.
